And as for tomorrow and the next year, they will have their turn presently.

arxiv-2103-04989.title: Deep learning-based super-resolution fluorescence microscopy on small datasets
arxiv-2103-04989.creator: Varun Mannam ∗, Yide Zhang, Xiaotong Yuan, Scott Howard
arxiv-2103-04989.description: Abstract Fluorescence microscopy has enabled a dramatic development in modern biology by visualizing biological organisms with micrometer scale resolution. However, due to the diffraction limit, sub-micron/nanometer features are difficult to resolve. While various super-resolution techniques are developed to achieve nanometer-scale resolution, they often either require expensive optical setup or specialized fluorophores.

arxiv-2106-04364.title: countBF: A General-purpose High Accuracy and Space Efficient Counting Bloom Filter
arxiv-2106-04364.creator: 1 st Sabuzima Nayak, 2 nd Ripon Patgiri
arxiv-2106-04364.description: Abstract Bloom Filter is a probabilistic data structure for the membership query, and it has been intensely experimented in various fields to reduce memory consumption and enhance a system’s performance. Bloom Filter is classified into two key categories: counting Bloom Filter (CBF), and non-counting Bloom Filter. CBF has a higher false positive probability than standard Bloom Filter (SBF), i.e.

arxiv-2202-09513.title: Soft streaming – flow rectification via elastic boundaries
arxiv-2202-09513.creator: Yashraj Bhosale, Tejaswin Parthasarathy, Mattia Gazzola
arxiv-2202-09513.description: Abstract Viscous streaming is an efficient mechanism to exploit inertia at the microscale for flow control. While streaming from rigid features has been thoroughly investigated, when body compliance is involved, as in biological settings, little is known. Here, we investigate body elasticity effects on streaming in the minimal case of an immersed soft cylinder.

arxiv-2212-04104.title: Some useful inequalities for nabla tempered fractional calculus Thanks: The work described in this paper was fully supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (62273092) and the National Key R & \& D Project of China (2020YFA0714300).
arxiv-2212-04104.creator: Yiheng Wei, Linlin Zhao, Kai Cao, Jinde Cao
arxiv-2212-04104.description: Abstract . This paper gives particular emphasis to the nabla tempered fractional calculus, which involves the multiplication of the rising function kernel with tempered functions, and provides a more flexible alternative with considerable promise for practical applications. Some remarkable inequalities for such nabla fractional calculus are developed and analyzed, which greatly enrich the mathematical theory of nabla tempered fractional calculus.

arxiv-2412-13397.title: Strings from Feynman Diagrams
arxiv-2412-13397.creator: Rajesh Gopakumar, Rishabh Kaushik, Shota Komatsu, Edward A. Mazenc & Debmalya Sarkar
arxiv-2412-13397.description: Abstract For correlators in 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 Super Yang-Mills preserving half the supersymmetry, we manifestly recast the gauge theory Feynman diagram expansion as a sum over dual closed strings. Each individual Feynman diagram maps on to a Riemann surface with specific moduli. The Feynman diagrams thus correspond to discrete lattice points on string moduli space, rather than discretized worldsheets.

arxiv-2502-18350.title: Graph Inference with Effective Resistance Queries
arxiv-2502-18350.creator: Huck Bennett, Mitchell Black, Amir Nayyeri, Evelyn Warton
arxiv-2502-18350.description: Abstract The goal of graph inference is to design algorithms for learning properties of a hidden graph using queries to an oracle that returns information about the graph. Graph reconstruction, verification, and property testing are all special cases of graph inference.

arxiv-2506-19146.title: Optimal Design of Experiment for Electrochemical Parameter Identification of Li-ion Battery via Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2506-19146.creator: Mehmet Fatih Ozkan, Samuel Filgueira da Silva, Faissal El Idrissi, Prashanth Ramesh, Marcello Canova
arxiv-2506-19146.description: Abstract Accurate parameter estimation in electrochemical battery models is essential for monitoring and assessing the performance of lithium-ion batteries (LiBs). This paper presents a novel approach that combines deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with an optimal experimental design (OED) framework to identify key electrochemical parameters of LiB cell models.

arxiv-2509-12298.title: SIMBA: A Python-based single-point astrochemical solver and analysis tool 2026 SIMBA: A Python-based single-point astrochemical solver and analysis tool – 9
arxiv-2509-12298.creator: Luke Keyte, Jason Ran
arxiv-2509-12298.description: Abstract Determining molecular abundances in astrophysical environments is crucial for interpreting observational data and constraining physical conditions in these regions. Chemical modelling tools are essential for simulating the complex processes that govern molecular evolution. We present simba , a new Python-based single-point astrochemical modelling package designed to solve chemical reaction networks across diverse astrophysical environments.

arxiv-2602-14098.title: ForgeryVCR: Visual-Centric Reasoning via Efficient Forensic Tools in MLLMs for Image Forgery Detection and Localization
arxiv-2602-14098.creator: Youqi Wang, Shen Chen, Haowei Wang, Rongxuan Peng, Taiping Yao, Shunquan Tan, Changsheng Chen, Bin Li, Shouhong Ding
arxiv-2602-14098.description: Abstract Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for image forgery detection and localization predominantly operate under a text-centric Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigm. However, forcing these models to textually characterize imperceptible low-level tampering traces inevitably leads to hallucinations, as linguistic modalities are insufficient to capture such fine-grained pixel-level inconsistencies.

arxiv-2602-19084.title: ucTrace : A Multi-Layer Profiling Tool for UCX-driven Communication
arxiv-2602-19084.creator: Emir Gencer, Mohammad Kefah Taha Issa, Ilyas Turimbetov, James D. Trotter, Didem Unat
arxiv-2602-19084.description: Abstract Unified Communication X (UCX) is a communication framework that enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication in HPC systems. With its unified API, UCX facilitates efficient data transfers across multi-node CPU-GPU clusters. UCX is widely used as the transport layer for MPI, particularly in GPU-aware implementations.

pmc-10671062.title: Terpenes in Cannabis sativa Inhibit Capsaicin Responses in Rat DRG Neurons via Na+/K+ ATPase Activation
pmc-10671062.creator: Uma Anand, Praveen Anand, Mikael Hans Sodergren
pmc-10671062.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Terpenes in Cannabis sativa exert analgesic effects, but the mechanisms are uncertain. We examined the effects of 10 terpenes on capsaicin responses in an established model of neuronal hypersensitivity. Adult rat DRG neurons cultured with neurotrophic factors NGF and GDNF were loaded with Fura2AM for calcium imaging, and treated with individual terpenes or vehicle for 5 min, followed by 1 µMol capsaicin. In vehicle treated control experiments, capsaicin elicited immediate and sustained calcium influx.

pmc-11355817.title: Insights into Probiotic Prescription among Gastroenterologists and Other Healthcare Professionals: Evidence from an Italian Survey
pmc-11355817.creator: Giovanni Marasco, Angelo Bruni, Olga Maria Nardone, Loris Riccardo Lopetuso, Peter Laszlo Lakatos
pmc-11355817.description: Background: Probiotics, which are live microorganisms that provide health benefits, have been extensively studied for their various clinical applications. However, despite their potential, high-quality data supporting their use in several gastrointestinal diseases are often lacking, and prescription behaviors can widely differ. This study aimed to assess different behaviors in probiotics knowledge and prescriptions among Italian gastroenterologists and healthcare professionals (HPs).

pmc-11405479.title: An audit of central venous catheter insertion and management practices in two French university hospitals
pmc-11405479.creator: Nagham Khanafer, Sophie Gardes, Nathalie De-Santis, Céline Liard, Florian Deschamps, Pauline Verbist, Stephane Nancey, Eddy Cotte, Olivier Martin, Laurent Argaud, Anne Claire Lukaszewicz, Philippe Vanhems
pmc-11405479.description: ObjectiveTo assess the compliance with French guidelines for the prevention of central venous catheter (CVC)-related infections in two university hospitals.MethodsAn observational audit was conducted in 7 wards using a digital tool.ResultsThe prerequisite of hand hygiene (HH) were respected by 90% of health-care worker; 86% performed HH prior to equipment preparation and 59% repeated it prior to infusion.

pmc-11679140.title: Characterization of an Inorganic Powder-Based Scintillation Detector Under a UHDR Electron Beam
pmc-11679140.creator: Daline Tho, Sam Beddar, Stefania Campopiano, Flavio Esposito, Andrei Stancalie, Agostino Iadicicco
pmc-11679140.description: (1) Background: Ultra-high dose rate (UHDR) radiation therapy needs a reliable dosimetry solution and scintillation detectors are promising candidates. In this study, we characterized an inorganic powder-based scintillation detector under a 9 MeV UHDR electron beam. (2) Methods: A mixture of ZnS:Ag powder and optic glue was coupled to an 8 m Eska GH-4001-P polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) optical fiber.

pmc-12650418.title: Hypoxia-Induced Extracellular Vesicles Derived from Human Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells Regulate Macrophage Polarization and Enhance Angiogenesis to Promote Diabetic Wound Healing
pmc-12650418.creator: Yongfeng Su, Junda Lu, Feiyuan Liang, Jianwen Cheng
pmc-12650418.description: Background: Diabetic wound healing has always been a clinical challenge with minimal response or efficacy to standard treatment. This study aims to assess the therapeutic potential of hypoxia-induced extracellular vesicles (hy-EVs) produced by human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (HUCMSCs) to treat diabetic wounds.

pmc-12750066.title: Development and Validation of a Revised Multidimensional Digital Health Literacy Scale: Secondary Analysis Using Cross-Sectional Data From the 2022 GetCheckedOnline Community Survey In British Columbia, Canada
pmc-12750066.creator: Ihoghosa Iyamu, Pierce Gorun, Hsiu-Ju Chang, Rodrigo Sierra-Rosales, Devon Haag, Heather Pedersen, Sofia Bartlett, Nathan Lachowsky, Geoffrey McKee, Catherine Worthington, Troy Grennan, Lorie Donelle, Daniel Grace, Mark Gilbert
pmc-12750066.description: BackgroundDigital technologies are reshaping health care, making digital health literacy (DHL) a critical competency for navigating online health information. Although widely conceived and measured as a unidimensional measure of DHL, the literature increasingly supports a multidimensional framing of the eHealth Literacy Scale (eHEALS).

pmc-13048755.title: Model-Informed Drug Development
pmc-13048755.creator: Yasaman Moghadamnia, Ryan Zurakowski, Mohammad Aminul Islam
pmc-13048755.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The pharmaceutical industry faces a major challenge in drug discovery and development, with overall success rates of only 10–20%, often due to reductionist approaches that fail to account for complex biological networks. To address this challenge, industry and regulatory agencies, including the FDA, are increasingly adopting Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) to improve dose optimization, trial design, and decision-making throughout the drug development pipeline.

pmc-13318081.title: Quality Evaluation of Large Language Model–Assisted Generation of Initial Senior Physician Ward Round Records for Patients With Acute Poisoning: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13318081.creator: Junping Zhu, Wei Pan, Yonghong Wang, Kui Yan, Zhicheng Fang, Xianyi Yang
pmc-13318081.description: BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs) have shown potential in medical text generation. Senior physician ward round records are critical documents whose quality reflects the accuracy and continuity of clinical decision-making. The initial record is particularly important, as it represents the first formal senior-level synthesis of a patient’s presentation, establishing the diagnostic framework and treatment direction for all subsequent care.

pmc-13380497.title: Brainwaves under medication: revealing class-specific neural signatures of psychotropic medication from 24,000 EEGs
pmc-13380497.creator: Magdalena Szponar, Patrycja Dzianok, Bartłomiej Gmaj, Wojciech Jernajczyk, Jan Kamiński
pmc-13380497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryBackgroundPsychotropic medications remain foundational in psychiatric care, yet the neurophysiological mechanisms through which they exert therapeutic and adverse effects are still poorly characterised, limiting the field's ability to optimise treatment selection and monitoring.

pmc-13397879.title: Prevalence and Impact of Pulmonary Hypertension Associated with Arteriovenous Fistulas and Grafts in End-Stage Renal Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13397879.creator: Ahmed A. Zayed, Mohammad Aldalahmeh, Salim Barakat, Georges Khattar, Walid Sange, Elie Bou Sanayeh, Zaid Khamis, Bahy Abofrekha, Suzanne El-Sayegh, Michel N. Chalhoub
pmc-13397879.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights What are the main findings? In a pooled analysis of observational studies, AVF/AVG use in dialysis patients was associated with higher odds of pulmonary hypertension than non-AVF/AVG access (pooled OR 2.06, 95% CI: 1.69–2.52).

pmc-13481367.title: Deep learning models based on CT predict prognosis in patients with locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma who received neoadjuvant immunotherapy and chemotherapy
pmc-13481367.creator: Junfeng Zhao, Zongqian Yuan, Huan Shi, Ying Li, Chunhui Li, Ruidan Zhang, Chengxin Liu
pmc-13481367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13527056.title: Direct observation of braiding of Majorana-like zero modes in real space
pmc-13527056.creator: Qiyun Ma, Hailong He, Weiyin Deng, Meng Xiao, Zhengyou Liu
pmc-13527056.description: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) lie at the heart of fault-tolerant topological quantum computation, where their non-Abelian braiding statistics enable logical operations intrinsically immune to local perturbations and decoherence. Analogs of MZMs, known as Majorana-like zero modes (MLZMs), have recently been proposed in artificial lattices.
